title: Trends in Intellectual Development in Down Syndrome
brief_summary: Previous foreign studies revealed that the IQ in Down syndrome (DS) declines with age, but not any investigation of domestic data in Taiwan was available. Individuals with DS are characterized by limited verbal development, and in this article, authors look into the diverging verbal-nonverbal abilities in the DS phenotype.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Down syndrome with psychological test results

Exclusion Criteria:

* Comorbidity of severe Autism or visual/auditory impairment
